small.title: Tip splitter
small.prompt: A tip and bill splitter for a restaurant table. Enter the bill and pick a tip of 10, 15 or 20 percent or type your own; set how many people; show what each person pays, rounded up to whole euros if I tick a box.

job.summary: A bill and tip splitter for a table.
job.name: tip-splitter

small.title: Dice and coin
small.prompt: A dice roller and coin flipper for board game nights. Roll one to six dice with a shake animation, flip a coin, and keep a short history of the last ten results.

job.summary: Dice roller and coin flip with history.
job.name: dice-and-coin

small.title: Focus timer
small.prompt: A focus timer: 25 minutes of work, then a 5 minute break, with a long break after four rounds. Big start and pause buttons, a sound when time is up, a count of rounds done today, and settings for the three lengths.

job.summary: A work/break focus timer with rounds.
job.name: focus-timer

small.title: Water tracker
small.prompt: A water tracker: tap a glass to add 250 ml, see progress toward a daily goal I can set, and see the last seven days as small bars. It resets at midnight.

job.summary: Daily water goal with a 7-day view.
job.name: water-tracker

small.title: Kitchen converter
small.prompt: A kitchen unit converter: cups, spoons, grams and millilitres for common ingredients like flour, sugar and butter; oven temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit and gas mark; and a recipe scaler that multiplies amounts.

job.summary: Cooking units, oven temperatures and scaling.
job.name: kitchen-converter

small.title: Breathing guide
small.prompt: A breathing exercise guide: a circle that grows and shrinks to show when to breathe in, hold and breathe out, with box breathing and 4-7-8 patterns to pick from, and a session length of one to ten minutes.

job.summary: Animated breathing patterns with a session length.
job.name: breathing-guide

small.title: Days until
small.prompt: A countdown page: add events with a name and a date, and see the days left until each one, soonest first. Past events move to a list at the bottom.

job.summary: Countdowns to my events, soonest first.
job.name: days-until

small.title: Team picker
small.prompt: A random team picker for a kids' football game: type the players' names once and keep them, pick who is playing today, then split them into two or more fair random teams with a reshuffle button.

job.summary: Fair random teams from a saved player list.
job.name: team-picker

medium.title: Habit streaks
medium.prompt: A habit tracker. Add habits with an emoji and a colour; tick them off each day on a home list; show each habit's current and best streak; a month calendar per habit; a weekly summary; a list of what is left today; and export and import of my data as a file.

job.summary: Habits with streaks, calendars and export.
job.name: habit-streaks

medium.title: Trip packing list
medium.prompt: A packing list for trips. Start a trip from templates (beach, city, ski, business); tick items as I pack; add my own items and categories; show how much is packed; copy a past trip; and a dark mode.

job.summary: Packing lists from templates with progress.
job.name: packing-list

medium.title: Plant care
medium.prompt: A plant care app. A list of my plants with a photo from the phone; how often each needs water and feeding; a today screen with what to water; a log of when I watered; snooze a plant for a day; and a care-tips page per plant type.

job.summary: Plant watering schedule with a log.
job.name: plant-care

medium.title: Score keeper
medium.prompt: A score keeper for board and card games. Set up players with colours; add points per round with big buttons; show a running total and a round-by-round table; undo the last entry; declare a winner at a target score; keep a history of past games; and per-player win counts.

job.summary: Board game scores with history and win counts.
job.name: score-keeper

medium.title: Flashcards
medium.prompt: A flashcard app with spaced repetition. Make decks; add cards with a front and back; study with a flip animation; rate each card as again, hard or easy and schedule it accordingly; show cards due today; deck stats; import cards from pasted text; and swipe gestures on the phone.

job.summary: Flashcard decks with spaced repetition.
job.name: flashcards

medium.title: Trip expenses
medium.prompt: An expense splitter for a group trip, kept on my phone. job.summary: Group trip expenses and who owes whom.
job.name: trip-expenses

medium.title: Workout log
medium.prompt: A gym workout log. A list of exercises; start a workout and log sets with weight and reps; a rest timer between sets; repeat my last workout; personal bests per exercise; a chart of one exercise over time; and a calendar of workout days.

job.summary: Gym sets, rest timer, bests and charts.
job.name: workout-log

medium.title: Chore chart
medium.prompt: A chore chart for kids on the family tablet. Add children and chores with points; each child ticks off their chores for the day; points add up toward rewards a parent sets; a parent screen behind a simple PIN to approve; a weekly board of who did what; and a reset each week.

job.summary: Kids chores with points and rewards.
job.name: chore-chart

large.title: Recipes and meal plan
large.prompt: A recipe book with a meal planner. job.summary: Recipe book, cook mode, week plan and shopping list.
job.name: meal-planner

job.summary: Budget per category with charts and CSV import.

large.title: Reading tracker

job.name: reading-tracker

large.title: Vocabulary trainer

job.summary: Portuguese word lists with four quiz modes.
job.name: vocab-trainer

large.title: Garden planner
large.prompt: A vegetable garden planner. job.summary: Garden bed grid, sowing calendar and harvest log.
job.name: garden-planner

large.title: Party planner
large.prompt: A birthday party planner for the host. large.prompt: A home inventory. Rooms and boxes; items with a photo, price, purchase date and where they are; warranty end dates with a list of what expires soon; search across everything; move items between rooms; a value total per room for insurance; tags; a lent-out list with who has what; a printable list per room; and export to a file.

job.name: home-inventory
